builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Yorick: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (1,217 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 54.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A summon-led side-lane fighter who prepares graves, marks a target for his walkers and traps escape routes. Maiden coordination and his own empowered attack create sustained pressure. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Trinity Force → Spear of Shojin → Serylda's Grudge. Grasp of the Undying keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Sterak's Gage, Hullbreaker.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Trinity Force → Spear of Shojin → Serylda's Grudge, with Grasp of the Undying.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Trinity Force → Spear of Shojin → Serylda's Grudge) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 54.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Trinity Force → Spear of Shojin → Serylda's Grudge.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Yorick's next Attack deals an additional [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.5) × AD] physical damage and restores [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] plus [6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10]% of his missing Health, reduced by [50]% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave.

When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.

Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=1050, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 100.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 200.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 250.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health and [50 / 75 / 100 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] Magic Attack Damage plus [2 / 3 / 4] Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals [2 / 2.5 / 3]% max Health magic damage.

After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane.
Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has [2 / 2 / 3 / 3 / 4] Health and disappears after [4] seconds.

Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals [(6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage, Slows by [0.3] for [1.5] seconds and marks champions and monsters for [4] seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of @Spell.YorickPassive:YorickPassiveGhoulMax@) and suffer [(0.13 / 0.16 / 0.19 / 0.22 / 0.25) × 100]% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain [(0.18 / 0.21 / 0.24 / 0.27 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.

Yorick raises a grave for every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=8, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 3, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 5, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] enemies that die near him. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave.

These graves can be used to Awaken Mist Walkers with [characterLevelInterpolation(100 → 300; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health and [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 100; raw flags preserved) + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] Attack Damage, up to [4] in an area.

builds.name: Mist magic siege
builds.summary: Test mist magic siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test mist magic siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Mourning Mist adds 0.03 AP percentage-point scaling to its target-max-health magic damage; Liandry supports that spell burn while Maiden's magic attack and marked-target followup supply a second magic pressure source. AP does not scale Mist Walker AD, so pet damage must be compared honestly.
testPlan: Required state: Maiden alive, E lands and enemy remains near owner followup attacks.
Measure E, Maiden and owner mark-followup damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak Q/ghoul physical damage and pet clearing can erase the siege.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not grant ghouls AP attack scaling or owner item on-hit inheritance.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Liandry's Torment, Bloodletter's Curse, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.hypothesis: A summon-led side-lane fighter who prepares graves, marks a target for his walkers and traps escape routes. Maiden coordination and his own empowered attack create sustained pressure. Fix graves, Mist Walker count and Maiden targeting. Pet damage and marks must be measured; lethality cannot assume all pets inherit every item passive or on-hit effect. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Yorick: Fix graves, Mist Walker count and Maiden targeting. Pet damage and marks must be measured; lethality cannot assume all pets inherit every item passive or on-hit effect.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

builds.goal: Test grave health spell bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Mist Walker and Maiden helper health scale from source owner health, while their damage uses AD[source modifier]; Bloodmail therefore tests health-to-AD pet durability and damage together. Sundered Sky rewards Yorick's own Q attack and Visage supports its missing-health heal, with E providing current armor reduction.

Compare pet health/damage with measured owner health and AD, plus Q healing.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Pet clearing and weak personal mobility prevent meaningful pressure.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.

Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
